objective: Recover old P2 attack capability while improving benign-OOD false alarms in one unified A+B student; commissioning is a later separate contribution.

historical_AB.access: identity only; no load or new forward

expanded_preparation.reuse: members/*/features.f32le and contexts.jsonl.gz listed in pinned manifest
expanded_preparation.access: E only; no decoding or rematerialization

old_teacher_inputs.identity_status: pins inherited from frozen records; container contents not reopened by this design; all mappings must be verified in authorized P
old_teacher_inputs.identity_array_access: UID and missing arrays only, all 25467 identity records; no labels or role arrays
old_teacher_inputs.numeric_representation_access: only the 9379 current-train A old-correct whitelist rows; unrequested compressed stream bytes remain uninterpreted

data.direct_supervision: all fixed 15073 true-label targets once per epoch, no exclusions
data.exposure: All current pools are exposed development assets. Historical P2 fit includes current-check labels. C2 has extra historical teacher exposure; equal direct student labels does not mean equal total knowledge exposure.

student.architecture: Linear(131,64) -> GELU(exact) -> GRU(64,128,1 layer,unidirectional,bias,dropout0) -> Linear(128,64) -> GELU(exact) -> Linear(64,1)
student.initialization: each arm independently copies identical sealed candidate_A student state; no sequential warm-start between arms
student.prefix_semantics: reuse plan offsets, exact causal target event states, reset boundaries, packed padding and F4 fields

C2_projection.input: causal GRU h at each eligible target event

schedule.owner_order: sort context keys by (SHA256(canonical(['paired-order-v1',2705,epoch,owner,key])),key), epoch 1..20, independently for A and B
schedule.buckets: q,r=divmod(N_owner,197); first r buckets contain q+1 ordered contexts, remaining buckets q
schedule.per_update_order: A then B; each microbatch forward once for all applicable losses; accumulate gradients, global clip once, optimizer step once
schedule.candidate_selection: final epoch20 only; all three final checkpoints sealed before E; no report/check driven selection

A_guard.eligible: current-train A and saved A hard at logit>=0 equals true label
A_guard.representative: E_c=UID-sorted eligible targets; start=int(sha256(context_key UTF8),16)%len(E_c); epoch e selects E_c[(start+e-1)%len(E_c)]
A_guard.pairs: all attack-representative/benign-representative pairs within original A bucket, distinct component, attack-first once
A_guard.final_audit: reuse final train logits to check union of actual training pairs; report violations, worst gap-minus-margin, family detail; no extra forward
A_guard.guarantee_limit: zero loss on one pair at fixed parameters only implies qS_attack-qS_benign >= min(s_A,(qA_attack-qA_benign)/2); not fixed-zero decisions or unseen-OOD guarantee

P2_feature.whitelist: current-train A targets with plan old_hard == true label
P2_feature.normalization: (E3.astype(float64)-normalizer_mean.astype(float64))/normalizer_scale.astype(float64), append missing=0 in float64, then cast all769 to float32
P2_feature.class_context_denominators: N_Ty=count contexts with >=1 eligible target of label y; materialize exact integers in P, both must be >0
P2_feature.raw_RMS: sqrt(0.5*sum_y mean_eligible_context mean_eligible_target mean_128(c^2)), float64 accumulation
P2_feature.scale: s_T=max(1e-6,raw_RMS); raw_RMS must be finite and strictly >0; freeze in P

P.purpose: verify immutable inputs and isolate the 9379 train-side P2 contribution targets; no optimizer or student forward

T.purpose: sequential C0,C1,C2 from same sealed A, one trajectory each

E.purpose: one final evaluation for every new candidate on train/check/expanded, reuse all historical references

stages.execution_on_exception: stop, seal reason, zero automatic retries; do not silently drop C2, rows, terms or remaining checks
stages.scientific_bad_result: report and seal all completed endpoints; no extra epochs, seeds or coefficient changes
stages.monitoring: persistent local supervisor and human-readable status; no periodic LLM polling
stages.budget_scope: each stage includes entry validation, actual work, result verification and sealing; none may be excluded from stage resource accounting

evaluation.primary_ranking_descriptor: empirical TPR@FPR<=0.01, pooled expanded attacks versus all18000 benign OOD, ties grouped at one global mathematical threshold
secondary_ranking: family recalls at the same pooled mathematical threshold
fixed_point_reports: 16 attack families plus macro and worst regression

contrasts.C2-C1: extra historical P2 knowledge plus auxiliary training package

evaluation.development_joint_gain: same contrast no worse in primary ranking, fixed overall/future/family-macro recall and benign pool-macro/worst FP, at least one better; single-seed tiny differences are not a breakthrough
evaluation.practical_milestone: reach old fixed-point attack/future references and jointly improve benign OOD; disclose any key family/pool collapse; no invented allowed-loss tolerance
evaluation.practical_verdict: manual scientific interpretation of the complete metric table; no automatic SUCCESS from undefined serious-regression tolerances
evaluation.reference_comparison: use exact numerator and denominator; rounded percentages are display only

new_candidate_retention_diagnostics.outputs: count,UIDs,is_zero separately for each C0/C1/C2; never replaces the historical two-arm verdict

claim_limits: not proof of feature superiority to other distillation
auxiliary regularization and shared clipping not isolated
one candidate failure does not falsify every knowledge-transfer method

implementation_acceptance: selective whitelist reads and identity/access accounting
original student forward equivalence and causal early-target states
P2 canonical numeric semantics and separately defined contribution reconstruction
all required train labels retained; B,old-wrong and check excluded only from the appropriate teacher term
context and class-context normalizations recover prescribed epoch objectives
identical A initialization, reset optimizers, batches, supervised presentations and update counts
guard representative/pair/margin support matches sealed metadata arithmetic
D zero-first-step behavior, later encoder gradient propagation and deployment removal
fixed final checkpoint and tie-aware pooled low-FPR computation
Windows persistent supervisor, resource bounds, clear terminal reason and zero automatic retry
synthetic acceptance and implementation sealing before seeking real P/T/E execution
